The two-step pattern separates value explanation from the OS permission dialog. Step one is in-product context; step two is the native system prompt. Badged soft-ask buttons make the pre-permission state legible. Anti-pattern: triggering the OS dialog on first launch cold. A decision matrix maps timing, trigger and copy variants.
